name: IQ-EQ Cosmos

web.notes: Dashboards on web and Apple/Android mobile. Login URL and MFA not published.

email_notifications.notes: IQ-EQ mentions automated text alerts on key metric changes.

notes: IQ-EQ's in-house reporting and portfolio monitoring platform with modules for GPs and LPs plus real estate, ESG and HNWI dashboards (high confidence, IQ-EQ page). Built by IQ-EQ's in-house team on its Snowflake-based Data Platform over FIS Investran, Allvue and PFS Paxus. Exports dashboards as PNG, PDF or PPT and data as Excel or CSV. Positioned more as analytics than a document portal; whether all administered funds' LPs get it is not confirmed (medium confidence).
